summary: (f | γf) and (f | γ_Z f) have the same invertible Gram matrix; Witt's theorem gives g with g(f | γf) = (f | γ_Z f); the elements fixing the frame are u(q)·embedH(k).

steps.lean:
have A {s} (z : realFrameGram s = Z) : (framePair s)ᴴ * 𝔰.J₁ * framePair s =
    fromBlocks (diagLast 0 - 1) Z Zᴴ
    (diagLast 0 - 1) := by simpa [← z] using congr(submatrix $(s.2) 𝔰.besselFrame 𝔰.besselFrame)
steps.claim: A: for s ∈ G₁(𝔰) with Z(s) = Z, the Gram matrix of the 2(ϱ+1) columns (f | sf) is [[diag(0,…,0,−1), Z], [Zᴴ, diag(0,…,0,−1)]] (the frame has Gram matrix diag(0, …, 0, −1), and h(f_a, s f_b) = Z_{ab}).
steps.typed_fact:
(framePair s)ᴴ * 𝔰.J₁ * framePair s =
    fromBlocks (diagLast 0 - 1) Z Zᴴ
    (diagLast 0 - 1)

steps.lean:
have B {s} z := HasLeftInv.of_isUnit_gram (isUnit_of_mul_isUnit_right (x := fromBlocks 0 Zᴴ⁻¹
    Z⁻¹ 0) (by rw [@A s z]; simp [h.1]; rw [det_of_isUpperTriangular] <;> simp [BlockTriangular,
    conj_mul', ← conjTranspose_nonsing_inv] <;> norm_cast <;> grind [cornerDefect_pos h,
    cornerDefect, invCorner]))
steps.claim: B: for such s, (f | sf) has a left inverse, because its Gram matrix (A) is invertible: multiplied by [[0, Zᴴ⁻¹], [Z⁻¹, 0]] it becomes block upper triangular with determinant a nonzero multiple of δ(Z) > 0.

steps.lean:
obtain ⟨g, e⟩ := witt ⟨I, by simp⟩ isHermitian isUnit (B y) (B (realFrameGram_gramSection h)) (A
    (realFrameGram_gramSection h) ▸ A y)
steps.claim: Witt's theorem (over ℂ, J₁(𝔰) hermitian and invertible): (f | γf) and (f | γ_Z f) have left inverses (B for γ and for γ_Z, as Z(γ_Z) = Z) and the same Gram matrix (A), so g(f | γf) = (f | γ_Z f) for some g ∈ G₁(𝔰).
Read off the blocks: gf = f and gγf = γ_Z f.

steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨q, k, a⟩, p, l, b⟩ := exists_embedH_eq_of_fix_frameCols e.1,
    @exists_embedH_eq_of_fix_frameCols _ ((gramSection Z)⁻¹ * g * γ) (by simp [e, -inclMatrix])
steps.claim: g fixes the frame, so g·u(q) = embedH(k) for some q, k; and γ_Z⁻¹gγ fixes the frame, so (γ_Z⁻¹gγ)·u(p) = embedH(l) for some p, l.

steps.lean: use q, k⁻¹, p, l⁻¹, by simp_rw [map_inv, ← a, ← b]; group
steps.claim: Then γ = g⁻¹γ_Z embedH(l)u(p)⁻¹ = u(q)embedH(k)⁻¹·γ_Z·(u(p)embedH(l)⁻¹)⁻¹: take (q, k⁻¹, p, l⁻¹).
